newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sales near midday Thursday were too light to test as the Independence Day holiday approaches, market sources said.
Major U.S. cattle slaughter and beef processing plants will be closed Friday for the holiday. Normal operations were seen for Saturday and Monday.

About 200 heifers that will likely grade select and choice sold at $102.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, but the volume was too light to establish a market, the sources said. This week's cattle sales were mostly at $103.00 and $64.00 on a live basis, with a little bit of carryover seen for next week.
